reason: Dropping the source and where clause is insufficient; joins use media_file_id, ordering uses playlist_tracks.id, so FROM, joins, columns, and ordering must also change.
Moving get_linkage to use get_fields('880') also requires loading 880 into the field cache; FIELDS_WANTED omits 880, so linkage returns nothing.
fieldMap is declared in persistence/sql_smartplaylist.go, not in the model package; the claim binds it to the wrong package.
Pinned go-cve-dictionary v0.8.4 exposes only NVD/JVN, but the task states the CVE database includes the Fortinet feed, so the refutation is debatable.
Mapping to identifiers.yml URL templates misses Google Scholar, which has no entry there; an additional config entry is required but unstated.
access_restricted_item='true' yields unclassified only when the edition is not inlibrary or printdisabled; collection precedence wins otherwise.
False is passed as the fallback flag; the no-value result is usertypes.UNSET. The code has no False 'no preference' sentinel.
Existing VPN modal copy (DowngradeModal) describes losing VPN features on downgrade, not disabling auto-pay, so reusing its key gives wrong text.
Overriding _validate_valid_values works but is not required; overriding to_py, as UniqueCharString does, also satisfies the requirements.
touchid api.go defines the nativeTID interface, not an uninitialized var native declaration; that variable exists only in platform files.
Splitting is needed for encoding insertion only when a shebang yields an interpreter; the None branch inserts nothing, so 'regardless' overreaches.
Deferring the required ServerNames field (and unstated splitting) leaves required work out; the raw comma string becomes one DNS SAN.
Requirements ask for both isKeyComboMatch and a public KeyCombo type; the claim leaves out KeyCombo.
'or' returns the first truthy operand only if one exists; with all operands falsy it returns the last operand.
Persistence-set function variables are one wiring choice; rule conversion can live in model, which already imports Squirrel, so it is not required.
useShareKey is also needed outside migration: getLink decryption of links with parentLinkId must propagate it per the issue.
Besides the ServerWithRoles and GRPCServer methods, IdentityService.DeleteMFADevice exists in lib/services/local/users.go; the count of two misses it.
The requirement specifies [...string] | string; the proposed bare [...] is an unconstrained list allowing non-string elements.
Most YAML tags include omitempty, but Flag.Enabled is tagged yaml:"enabled" without it, so the blanket statement fails.
For this /api/v3 route, setupApiRoute's wrapper catches controller errors and calls formatApiResponse(400); they do not reach the global handler.
The task requires a module-level extra_suffixes_workaround and no remaining class-bound reference, so keeping a static wrapper contradicts requirements.
VendorSeverity is map[SourceID]Severity with no Cvss3Severity field; empty cvss3Severity entries come from the separate CVSS loop, not VendorSeverity.
The Ctrl/Cmd+F path gates on ctrlCmdOnly from isOnlyCtrlOrCmdKeyEvent, which requires !ev.shiftKey, so Shift is checked.
Viper v1.7.0 only lowercases keys and does exact path lookup; underscore names come from Flipt's own constants, not Viper.
HostCA-only cannot verify UserCA-signed client certs, and first-key-pair-only rejects valid rotated certs, so the reductions break handshakes.
DeviceDetails-test.tsx also imports DeviceDetails; the exclusivity claim leaves out the test importer.
Only cu31924091184469 has textual 880; nybc200247_marc.xml already has real 880 datafields, so concluding a new XML fixture is needed overgeneralizes.
package.json declares ^4.2.2, but yarn.lock and node_modules resolve diff-dom to 4.2.8; 4.2.2 is only the range's lower bound.
Baseline has no qt_64 variant, but by step 73 the agent had added qt_64 via copy_replace_setting on qt_63, so claim fits its code.
camelCase convention holds, but checkForUpdates is not an existing tag in config.go; the cited example does not exist.
Passing an array privilege with the existing [0] cid makes both arrays, hitting invalid-data; the cid argument must also change.
persistence declares 'type SmartPlaylist model.SmartPlaylist' without '=', a defined type, not a type alias; the alias property is wrong.
useDebouncedFunction returns a Promise and calls the callback with only an abort signal; no returned function exists whose parameters to match.
Plaintext must be available, but not necessarily kept in User.Password after validation; passing the decrypted password separately also satisfies requirements.
Only the integer channel count is required; capturing the remainder then splitting on the first comma also yields stereo -> 2, so not necessary.
read_file returns cached content on a cache hit before calling _resource_path or read_text, so cached reads never touch the filesystem.
sorted.js obtains helpers via a local require('./helpers'); no module.helpers property exists on the passed Redis object.
A new delegatedAuthentication object holding the five values satisfies the requirement; storing the raw object is optional, and the intersection type is unsupported.
JavaScript closures capture outer bindings; the callback directly reads encryptedLink, shareId, and revisionId from the enclosing scope.
strings.Fields splits only on whitespace, so hyphenated headers stay intact; the stated causal premise is backwards.
